name: WPA FUTURES 2040
subtitle: Human Authority, Protocol and Institutional Governance in the Age of AI
purpose: Create a WPA-owned foresight method that combines horizon scanning, alternative scenarios, institutional stress tests, structured expert assessment, action design and human-governed implementation.
methodological_note: The framework is informed by established scenario and participatory foresight practice, including the scenario -> expert assessment -> workshop -> action logic used by The Millennium Project. No partnership, endorsement or methodological ownership transfer is implied.
research_domains: Public Communication, Media and Social Coherence

scenario_set.name: Managed Human-AI Institutions
scenario_set.logic: AI capability increases while institutions preserve explicit human mandate, provenance, bounded agency, temporal authorisation, Human Gates and final human responsibility.

scenario_set.name: Protocol Without Authority
scenario_set.logic: Institutions formally remain human-led while AI systems gradually become the de facto source of decisions, communications and operational sequencing without equivalent mandate visibility.

scenario_set.name: Institutional Legitimacy Crisis
scenario_set.logic: Persistent and increasingly autonomous systems operate across institutional boundaries while authority, provenance, revocation and responsibility become difficult to reconstruct.

questions: Authority: who has the legitimate right to decide?
Mandate: who authorised the AI or system to act?
Time: when does authority expire or require renewal?
Provenance: can the instruction and decision chain be demonstrated?
Human Gate: where is attributable human authorisation mandatory?
Responsibility: who remains finally institutionally accountable?

observatory.name: WPA Institutional Futures Observatory
observatory.function: Horizon scanning, signal triage, evidence-backed trend notes and scenario inputs; not intelligence or surveillance activity.

expert_network.name: WPA International Expert Network
expert_network.membership_rule: No person is represented as a member or adviser without explicit acceptance.
expert_network.reuse_logic: Journal authors, invited lecturers, AAB participants and external experts may be separately invited to specific research panels; one role never implies another.

research_cycle: Policy brief / research report / educational scenario
pilot_12_18_months: Structured expert assessment / Delphi-compatible design where methodologically appropriate
Western Balkans or thematic regional workshop if partners and funding are confirmed

funding_positioning.programme_name: WPA Institute Programme on Human Authority & AI Governance
funding_positioning.principle: Seek support for a public-interest research and policy programme, not merely for printing a private book.

integration_role: WPA FUTURES 2040 is the foresight and institutional stress-test component used by WIIE for major strategy, technology and institutional-design missions.
